## Endpoints

### Auth Flow (11)
- `GET /fba/i2i/gateway/csrfToken` — Get a CSRF token for the FBA I2I gateway.
- `GET /fba/i2i/gateway/workflows/{workflowToken}` — Retrieve an FBA I2I workflow using a token.
- `GET /fba/i2i/gateway/workflows/{workflowToken}/{workflowId}` — Get a specific workflow from the I2I gateway.
- `GET /fba/i2i/gateway/workflows/{workflowToken}/shipments/{shipmentToken}` — Get details for a specific shipment.
- `GET /fba/i2i/gateway/workflows/{workflowToken}/shipments/{shipmentToken}/{shipmentId}` — Get details for a specific shipment by ID.
- `GET /fba/i2i/gateway/workflows/{workflowToken}/shipments/{shipmentToken}/packages/containers` — Get containers for a shipment package.
- `GET /fba/i2i/proxyService/workflows/{workflowToken}/placementOptionGroups` — Get placement option groups for a workflow.
- `GET /fba/inbound/skuconfig/csrftoken` — Get a CSRF token for FBA SKU configuration.
- `GET /i18n/{i18nToken}` — Retrieve internationalization (i18n) data.
- `GET /static/{staticToken}` — Retrieve static content.
- `POST /fba/i2i/gateway/workflows/{workflowToken}/manifests/{manifestToken}/packages/skuBoxes` — Post SKU box data to a manifest package.

### Data Read (11)
- `GET /account-switcher/global-and-regional-account/merchantMarketplace` — Get the seller's available marketplaces.
- `GET /conversation-api/v1/sidebarContext` — Get context for the seller's sidebar.
- `GET /fba/controlplane/v1/navigation` — Get FBA navigation data.
- `GET /fba/i2i/proxyService/{proxyServiceId}` — Get data from an FBA I2I proxy service.
- `GET /fba/i2i/proxyService/itemImgUrl/B082LWM432%2CB08PW6HL7J` — Get item image URLs for specified ASINs.
- `GET /fba/i2i/proxyService/transportationConstraints/SMF3/{SMF3Id}` — Get transportation constraints for a location.
- `GET /fba/inbound/arest/addressbook/address/sta-ship-from` — Get a specific ship-from address.
- `GET /fba/sendtoamazon/i18n/{i18nJwt}` — Get localized text for Send to Amazon.
- `GET /fba/sta-api/display-preference` — Get the seller's FBA display preferences.
- `GET /mons/weblabs/merchant/treatment` — Get A/B test treatment for a seller.
- `GET /trim/json/favorites/sellerCentral` — Get the seller's saved Seller Central favorites.

### Data Write (9)
- `POST /asin-spotlight/graphql` — Submit a GraphQL query for ASIN spotlight data.
- `POST /business-reports/api` — Submit a request for business reports.
- `POST /fba/i2i/proxyService/{proxyServiceId}` — Proxy FBA Inbound to Inbound (I2I) service requests.
- `POST /insightswidget-api/growth` — Submit a request for growth insights widget data.
- `POST /learn/batch-load-su-widgets` — Load Seller University widgets in batch.
- `POST /mons/weblabs/merchant/trigger` — Trigger a merchant weblab event.
- `POST /pulse/v1/question` — Submit a question via Pulse.
- `POST /tricorder/{tricorderId}/` — Send data to Tricorder for diagnostics.
- `PUT /fba/i2i/proxyService/fteLanding` — Update the FTE landing flag.

### Realtime (1)
- `POST /1/events/com.amazon.eel.katal.metrics.core.nexus.sellercentral` — Send a real-time event to Amazon.

### Config (1)
- `GET /staRemotesConfig.json` — Get remote configuration data.
